checks: 13 named tests per execution: 12 library synthetic tests (including corefud parser) and one main load test; twice debug and twice release

Seven temporary compiled production controls target doc quote reset, corefud rightmost close, it weather classification, mention coordination number, eval visibility, sieve principle B, main retree loading
Exact source restoration and positive rerun after each control
Nine source syntax projections generated twice and compared byte-for-byte
cost: Document construction O(sum n²+n log n); mention extraction conservative O(sum n³+M log M+text bytes); resolver conservative O(S M³ L+S M² n+S M² log M). Evaluation repeats these for named baseline/cumulative configurations and delegates metric assignment to existing coref-score (dense Hungarian worst O(r²c)). Writer conservative O(B+NM log M). This is symbolic source analysis, not timing or optimized-bound evidence.
description: For checked raw U, D=documents(U), M=detect(D), R=ordered_sieves(classify_it(M,D),config), E=visible_partition(R). Metric observation is score_doc(gold_of(Dgold), recomputed_span_heads(E)); serialized output is write(U,D,out_mentions(R)). doc::retree optionally replaces tree columns before D, retaining original gold Entity; gold scorer must use original gold-tree document. eval::run checks original gold self-score, then paired document count, renders repeated configurations, strips raw Entity and reconstructs documents for a leak comparison before final output.
forward: For checked raw U, D=documents(U), M=detect(D), R=ordered_sieves(classify_it(M,D),config), E=visible_partition(R). Metric observation is score_doc(gold_of(Dgold), recomputed_span_heads(E)); serialized output is write(U,D,out_mentions(R)). doc::retree optionally replaces tree columns before D, retaining original gold Entity; gold scorer must use original gold-tree document. eval::run checks original gold self-score, then paired document count, renders repeated configurations, strips raw Entity and reconstructs documents for a leak comparison before final output.

doc supplies kids/depth/sub/quote to mention and it; mention fields feed sieve masks/head keys/candidate order; sieve returns full membership (including internal mentions) to eval; visible tests full cluster length before filtering. eval::sys_entities recomputes head via corefud::span_head, whereas out_mentions writes detector head, so no universal head equality is claimed. score is existing external sibling ownership. main::load joins strict CoNLL-U reading and optional retree, then documents. tests assertions cross actual joins and do not substitute copied algorithms.
inverse: For admitted default pipeline inputs, forbidden observations include Entity-dependent span/eid/note output, internal mentions in external entities, emitted unclosed/cross-sentence read mentions and cluster splitting. This relation is scoped: strip leak witness compares only span/eid/note; head/etype independence is not established by that check, and Nearest is outside default binding exclusions.

R(output) is the set of raw documents, environment/config snapshots and merge traces whose parsing/detection/visibility/serialization equals the observation. Gold Entity variants, discarded syntax/comments, invisible mentions, OR-mask provenance and old MISC annotations can vary. After rebuilding Entity views from raw output, parsed generated output recovers span/eid pairs only for sentence-bounded, stack-compatible same-eid spans (including serialized e prefixes); valid crossing same-eid spans can reconstruct different spans. Existing Document views stay stale after raw write. Original text annotation, resolver trace and retree-discarded word DEPS are unrecoverable.
limitations: Finite witnesses and partial lexical AST; not semantic proof or exhaustive branch coverage.
No useful executable percent surrogate for categorical/effect semantics. Supported future caps1/2/5/10% only.
from_words cyclic documents may reach nonterminating downstream closure; public malformed vectors and allocation/overflow faults untested.
CLI dispatch/argv and late filesystem failure atomicity remain partial; eval writes error output before leak check.
score_all and writer zip truncate unequal slices; orchestration must supply matching lengths.
state: All transport coordinates are sentence index and zero-based inclusive word span; output relative head uses +1. On valid acyclic documents, resolver merges preserve partition and only coarsen it. Visibility removes internal mentions and singleton coordination groups before external scoring/writing. No gold Entity feeds ordinary detection/resolution. Source-specific exceptions remain: nearest bypasses reading/binding, speaker can bypass person agreement, from_words does not certify acyclicity.
